statement: Where a worker begins employment, the employer must give the worker a written statement of particulars of employment; subject to section 2, the principal particulars must be included in a single document given not later than the beginning of the employment.
caveat: The duty covers workers, not only employees, following the 6 April 2020 amendment. Section 2 permits certain particulars to be given in separate or later documents; the full list of required particulars is in section 1(3) and (4). Check the current text for the list.
